meta_description: MW Plastering Sheffield offers professional plastering services including skimming, rendering and decorative finishes. Quality workmanship, competitive rates. Call today.
hero_subhead: From cracked ceilings to full-room skimming, we deliver smooth, long-lasting finishes on time and within budget.
services_subhead: Whether you need interior skimming, external rendering, or decorative plaster finishes, we handle every job with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Skimming
services.desc: Smooth, even skimming on walls and ceilings. We prepare, prime and finish to a flawless standard, ready for decoration.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant rendering in cement, silicone or acrylic. Protects your property and transforms its appearance.

services.title: Artex Removal & Replacement
services.desc: Safe removal of dated Artex with replacement skimming or textured finishes tailored to your home's style.

services.title: Plasterboard Installation
services.desc: Stud walls, ceilings and partitioning fitted with precision. Ideal for renovations, extensions and new builds.

services.title: Patch Repairs & Remedial Work
services.desc: Cracks, damp patches and impact damage repaired seamlessly. We match existing textures and finishes exactly.

services.title: Decorative Finishes
services.desc: Feature walls, polished plaster and bespoke textures. We specialise in period-appropriate finishes for listed properties.

about_pullquote: I built this business on doing the job right, first time, every time.
about_para_1: MW Plastering was founded in 2012 with one goal: deliver plaster finishes that homeowners and builders could trust. Over twelve years, we've completed over 400 projects across Sheffield and South Yorkshire—from Victorian terraces to modern new builds. Our reputation is built on showing up on time, leaving sites clean, and always exceeding expectations.
about_para_2: We're a small, focused team led by a qualified plasterer with over 15 years' hands-on experience. Every project gets the same attention to detail, whether it's a single room or a full renovation. Many of our clients come back to us for repeat work, and we're regularly recommended by local builders and architects who know they can rely on us.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our lounge ceiling—it was cracked and uneven but Mark made it look brand new. He was tidy, professional and quoted exactly what he said it would cost. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had the whole upstairs skimmed before we decorated. Quick, clean, and the finish is flawless. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend MW to anyone. Already booked them back for the kitchen.
reviews.author: Emma T.

reviews.text: Removed our old Artex and replaced it with a smooth finish. Two-day job, no mess left behind, and they even moved a few bits of furniture so we didn't have to. Fair price and honest bloke. Top marks.
reviews.author: Robert M.

emergency_banner_text: Urgent plaster repair needed? We prioritise emergency jobs and can often visit within 48 hours. Get in touch —
